The condition-two limiting objective polynomials have the stated exact roots, giving the complete strict threshold; the angle-gap scaling follows from the determinant. 181 independent rational/threshold assertions supplement but do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: An exact uniformly quantified no-constant-damping safeguard result and a sharp asymptotic angle-dependent objective criterion address an algorithmic design gap: decreasing trajectory separation is not a bound on either objective. Fixed-condition-number and bounded-start assumptions exclude trivial pathology from ill-conditioning or huge initialization. The theorem motivates safe clipping and monitoring; it does not mischaracterize safeguarded hybrid convergence.
